root_cause_analysis.symptom: THREE parallel gaps after cycle 20260505-061047 (BA-iter0 incorrectly counted two; QA OBJ-2 corrected): (1) search_notes_light tool exists in source + install but no production agent calls it; (2) install path is writable between deploys so a future hand-edit (or npm install -g) silently wipes 25 stealth fragments + the new tool; (3) mcp_client.py:150 silently drops content blocks 1..N for any multi-block MCP response — a latent data-integrity bug. Item #10 (AC2 retroactive on closed cycle) is a separate sub-item of category 3 and stays defensibly deferred per OOSO[0].
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: (1) Practical-value gap: prior cycle was scoped to source-of-truth reconciliation, not consumer-side wiring. The 4-codex-round development of search_notes_light produced the implementation but no cycle yet activated it in the meals/attractions/skill consumers. (2) Defense-in-depth gap: prior cycle deliberately deferred arch-prop-2 + arch-prop-3 to a follow-up because (a) minimum-safest-precise scope and (b) arch-prop-3 is breaking_changes:true requiring pre-flight grep across adjacent automation. The pre-flight has now been completed by this cycle's architect prescription. (3) Multi-block bug: mcp_client.call_tool() at line 150 takes content[0] only. The MCP spec returns content[] as a list of typed blocks (text/image/resource); current code drops blocks 1..N. Rare today (search_notes_light returns a single block) but a silent-data-loss landmine for any future tool that returns N>1 text blocks.
